tasks.description: Add a new guide under doc/user/content/ingest-data/postgres/ (e.g. dedicated-replica.md) explaining how to stand up a dedicated PostgreSQL replica using native logical replication (pg_basebackup/primary_conninfo, wal_level=logical, hot_standby_feedback) and point a Materialize PostgreSQL source at the replica host instead of the production primary, including the CREATE CONNECTION/CREATE SOURCE steps and caveats (replication slot on replica, failover).
Register the new dedicated-replica guide in the shared PostgreSQL integration guides list so it appears on the PostgreSQL ingest-data index and is linked from the CREATE SOURCE PostgreSQL pages.

branches.question: Where does the documentation describe PostgreSQL sources, including connection parameters and any guidance on replication slots or dedicated replicas?
Does the docs cover native logical replication setup, publication creation, or replica configuration for PostgreSQL?
Where is the PostgreSQL source reference page and what sections exist for connection and replication options?
Does the self-hosted PostgreSQL integration guide already cover standing up a dedicated replica or point a source at a non-primary host?
Is there any existing guidance on logical replication from a standby/replica (e.g., hot_standby_feedback, pg_basebackup, primary_conninfo) in the docs?
Where is the PostgreSQL integration guide index that lists guides, to know where a new replica guide would be linked?
What does the self-hosted PostgreSQL guide's later sections (after network security) cover, and does it include any guidance on pointing the source at a non-primary host or a dedicated replica?
What is the shared include file that lists PostgreSQL integration guides, so a new replica guide could be registered there?
Does the postgres_source_details YAML include any considerations about replication slots, primary vs replica, or hot_standby_feedback that a replica guide should reference?
